subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Swiss Cheese Model
description: A fast breakdown of The Swiss Cheese Model for builders.

hook.text: One mistake rarely causes a disaster. It takes multiple failures, aligned perfectly, to create catastrophe.

buildup.text: James Reason's Swiss cheese model shows that each defense layer has holes. Disasters happen when holes align.

discovery.text: Aviation uses this model to design redundant safety layers. No single failure can bring down a plane.

twist.text: Financial firms have fewer redundant layers. A single failure point can cascade into massive losses.

climax.text: Building multiple independent layers of defense is the best protection against complex system failures.

punchline.text: Every layer has holes. Disasters happen when they align.

quiz.question: What does the Swiss cheese model illustrate?
options: Disasters require multiple aligned failures across defense layers
A single mistake always causes a disaster
Swiss banks are the safest in the world
